title: .bbm.bld sidecar
description: Fork-only metadata for a BlueBrick .bbm map: cross-layer modules, anchored text labels, and event-venue geometry. Lives next to the .bbm so vanilla BlueBrick 1.9.2 can still open the .bbm cleanly without needing any fork awareness.

schemaVersion.description: Sidecar schema version. 1 is the only version shipped so far. Readers should reject versions newer than they understand.

bbmHashSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the sibling .bbm file's bytes at the time this sidecar was written. On load, readers compare against the current .bbm hash — a mismatch means the .bbm was edited externally (e.g. in vanilla BlueBrick), and anchored-label targets / module members may need re-linking. Empty string = hash not computed.

anchoredLabels.description: Text labels whose position sticks to a target item (brick / group / module) when the target moves or rotates. On .bbm save, also written flattened to world-coordinate text cells so vanilla still renders them in the right place at snapshot time.

modules.description: Cross-layer groups — bundles items across multiple layers into a named unit that moves or rotates together. A module's per-layer subset is also written as a vanilla same-layer Group inside the .bbm so vanilla sees reasonable grouping within each affected layer.

venue.description: Optional physical event space the layout targets: outline, edge classifications (wall / door / open), interior obstacles, walkway buffer. A project has at most one venue. Vanilla BlueBrick has no Venue concept; the .bbm.bld is the only place this lives.

budgetLimits.description: The layout's budget: part number -> how many of that part the layout may use (0 = none; a part without an entry is unlimited or forbidden by the reader's preference, as in BlueBrick). Present, even empty, when the layout has a budget; absent when it has none. Shared with everyone who edits the layout (the live document keeps it at meta.budgetLimits). A BlueBrick .bbb file is the same list in XML. Added 2026-11, optional.

switchStates.description: How the layout's switches are set: "<brick id>/<heel connection>" -> the connection a train leaves by. A switch without a key is set to its default (the way that turns least); absent when none is set. Shared with everyone who edits the layout (the live document keeps it at meta.switchStates). Never in a .bbm. Added 2026-11, optional.

routes.description: Named routes: { id, name, train, from, to, via, steps, color }; places on the track are { brick, from, to, s }, steps { brick, from, to }. Unknown fields are kept. Live at meta.routes (a Y.Map of id -> a Y.Map of fields). Never in a .bbm. Added 2026-11, optional.

rollingStock.description: Engines and cars: { id, number, name, kind, type, trackKind, length, width, bodyLength, trucks: [{ at, swivelMax }], couplers: { front, rear }, powered, look: { mode (simple, part or model), color, partKey }, model?: { partKey, file, format, importedAt } (an imported model's), libraryId?, libraryVersion?, notes, opsCut? (the cut or train it stands in), opsLoad? (loaded or empty), opsWaybill? (the waybill in its pocket), opsHome? (a place), opsAt? (a place off the layout), opsHold? (set aside) } in studs; a truck's at is studs from the car's middle, + towards its front. Unknown fields are kept. Live at meta.rollingStock (a Y.Map of id -> a Y.Map of fields). Never in a .bbm. Added 2026-11, optional.

trains.description: Trains: { id, name, trackKind, units: [{ stock, reversed }], position, color, speed, cut? (cars standing on the track), over? (how it stands over switches), emptiedAt? }; position is the head car's front truck as a place on the track plus facing (to or from), or null when not on the map. Unknown fields are kept. Live at meta.trains. Never in a .bbm. Added 2026-11, optional.

waybills.description: Waybills: { id, car (its id, or empty while it waits for one), from, leg (the slot it is on, 1 to 4; 0: finished), to1, spot1, load1, note1 ... to4, spot4, load4, note4 }: four slots, those with a to (a place's id) used. In a car's pocket when the car's opsWaybill names it too. Unknown fields are kept. Live at meta.waybills (a Y.Map of id -> a Y.Map of fields). Never in a .bbm. Added 2026-11, optional.

opsJobs.description: Jobs: { id, name, kind (local, yard, through or turn), train, order, stop_<id>: { place, at } ... }, the stops in at order, the jobs in order. Unknown fields are kept. Live at meta.opsJobs. Never in a .bbm. Added 2026-11, optional.

layoutPlaces.description: The layout's own places (Live Ops), on track that is in no module; a module's are in its places. Live at meta.places, one Y.Map a place. Never in a .bbm. Added 2026-11, optional.

trainScale.description: The scale trains run at, 1:trainScale (a train's speed is scale km/h). Absent: 1:38. Live at meta.trainScale. Never in a .bbm. Added 2026-11, optional.

place.description: A place where cars go (core/Places.h): an industry, a yard, staging or an interchange. Fields a newer build added are kept.

track.description: The piece of track it was picked on: a way through a part. Absent: none.

capacity.description: Cars it holds. Absent: worked out from the track.

role.description: A yard track's use: arrival, departure, class, rip, engine.

source.description: A placed module's place: its id in the Module library.

color.description: Color with optional KnownColor preservation for round-trip.

known.description: True iff this color came from a .NET KnownColor enum rather than free-form ARGB.

name.description: KnownColor enum name (e.g. 'Red', 'Black'). Present iff known=true.

font.description: Font spec round-tripped as .NET System.Drawing.Font triple.

kind.description: AnchorKind — 0=World (absolute world-stud offset), 1=Brick (offset is in target-brick local coords; moves with the brick), 2=Group (attached to an upstream same-layer Group), 3=Module (attached to a cross-layer Module).

targetId.description: guid of the anchor target. Meaning depends on `kind`: brick.guid for Brick, group.guid for Group, module.id for Module, ignored (empty) for World.

offset.description: Offset from the anchor, in studs. Interpretation depends on `kind` (world coords for World, local coords for everything else).

rot.description: Rotation of the label relative to the target, in degrees.

minZoom.description: Optional visibility cutoff: label hidden at zooms below this. 0 = always visible.

members.description: guids of every item in the module, across any layer. Can include brick / text / ruler guids.

transform.description: 3×3 QTransform matrix in row-major order (m11 m12 m13 m21 m22 m23 m31 m32 m33). Identity is [1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1].

sourceFile.description: Path of the .bbm this module was imported from, when applicable. Relative or absolute is caller-dependent.

importedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the import. Absent when the module was created from selection rather than imported.

showName.description: The module's name shows on the map. Written only when false.

outlineColor.description: The module's outline color; absent for the default light blue.

nameColor.description: The module's name color; absent for the default light blue.

sameColor.description: The outline and name colors change together. Written only when false.

pinned.description: Pinned in place: not moved or turned as a whole. Written only when true.

table.description: What the module stands on (core/ModuleSetup.h). Absent: not set. Store and show only.

type.description: MILS, plain baseplate (loose baseplates on an ordinary table) or custom.

heightMm.description: The height entered, in mm, to a tenth.

measuredTo.description: "rail": measured to the top of the rails. Absent: to the table top.

power.description: What the module needs from the wall (core/ModuleSetup.h). Absent: not set.

outlets.description: Outlets it uses; absent counts as one. Only when needed.

watts.description: Roughly how many watts. Only when needed.

plugSide.description: Which side the plug comes out; front is the side people watch from.

places.description: The module's places (Live Ops, core/Places.h). Absent: none.

enabled.description: Allows the user to toggle the venue off without deleting it.

minWalkwayStuds.description: Minimum walkway clearance from the inside of Door / Open edges. In studs (converted to/from mm per BlueBrick convention: 1 stud = 8 mm).

bounds.description: Optional explicit reserved layout footprint. When empty, the footprint is inferred from `edges`.

edges.description: Closed loop of segments making up the venue perimeter. Each edge is polyline + kind. Order matters (adjacent edges share endpoints).

obstacles.description: Interior polygons (pillars, columns, fixed furniture) that bricks mustn't overlap.

lengthUnit.description: The unit the venue's lengths are shown in (the Venue Designer's Units pick): "m" or "studs". Absent, or a value a reader doesn't know, means feet and inches. Stored lengths stay in studs. Added 2026-11, optional.

kind.description: EdgeKind — 0=Wall (solid barrier, no walkway buffer needed), 1=Door (walkway clearance required; `doorWidthStuds` > 0), 2=Open (no barrier, indicates viewing side; walkway buffer applies).

doorWidthStuds.description: Door clear width in studs. Only meaningful when `kind == 1` (Door).

poly.description: Segment polyline in world studs. Most edges are two points; curved doors can use more.
